technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish (EMA/SMA 50/200) with positive volume divergence, but short-term momentum is weak with price below key moving averages, negative MACD, and oversold oscillators showing no clear reversal confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AEE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 44 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC event in 1 day creates imminent volatility spike, and utilities face credit stress in tightening environment; earnings in 44 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish structure with positive OBV divergence and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) offers asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC volatility spike in 1 day), price below all key moving averages, no momentum confirmation, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 44 days create unacceptable risk for swing entry.
